title: Beyond Hate Speech: NLP’s Challenges and Opportunities in Uncovering Dehumanizing Language
measurement_description: Evaluation of LLMs for their ability to detect dehumanizing language, with a focus on systematic disparities in model performance across various target groups, including religious ones (Muslims, Jewish people), and error patterns like over-sensitivity and recognition blindness for these groups.
findings: For Muslims, Qwen, Mistral, and GPT show wider performance disparities, with performance dropping significantly. Mistral exhibits pronounced over-sensitivity (false positives) for Muslims, and Claude also shows elevated false positives for Muslims, though at lower levels. Performance for Jewish people was also evaluated, but specific findings related to disparities or errors for this group are not explicitly detailed.
references: Anthropic. 2025. Claude 3.7 sonnet. Available via Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
